shotObservations.observation: The same guardian, terminal and circular blue-lit room remain identifiable while the camera advances. Foreground rails and the curved structure create a strong parallax reveal and progressively uncover the subject; no freeze, replacement or spatial discontinuity was observed.

The cut is legible and preserves the guardian-terminal relationship, material identity and blue/coral palette. The hand/contact composition and the terminal/core light progression remain causally readable, with continuous close camera motion and no identity jump.

The close cut preserves the guardian helmet, shoulder, illuminated chest/core detail and room light bars. The motion-aware camera maintains the subject inside frame through the full slow push without boundary collapse or visible temporal break.

observedLimitations: The foreground rail and curved structure dominate much of the opening wide shot; this is a real composition risk for the final proof even though the reveal remains readable.
The medium shot stays tightly framed on the guardian's back and arm, limiting facial or eyeline storytelling and leaving little negative space.
The 640x360 Eevee 16-spp images show diagnostic softness and low-detail stylized assets; they do not establish photorealism or final cinematic polish.
The animatic has no authored audio and does not validate sound-picture timing.
